decisionsTitle: The volunteers' page tells the steps and that the organizers will confirm — before the form, after it and in the receipt — and the form is as wide as the register page
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-16:** «trebuie să îi spunem voluntarului care sunt pașii și că urmează să îl aprobăm (similar cu flow-ul participanților)», then «e prea îngust tot formularul». Amends §768 (the page), §773 and §797 (the form and its banner), §754 and §761 (the receipt email) and the privacy notice's template (section 10).

**Before the form.** `volunteers/ui/VolunteerSteps.tsx` draws «Cum funcționează voluntariatul» under the intro and above «Ce ești dispus(ă) să faci», in the shape of the registration's `RegistrationSteps` (§91): four steps with a glyph each — (1) you fill in the form, (2) you get the receipt email with the agreement you accepted attached, nothing to press, (3) the organizers choose your role and confirm you — you are told by email, with the date and place, the meeting time comes from them, nothing is owed until then — and (4) the day. **Open on the volunteers' page** (decided by the dispatcher): the page is the form itself, so the list is visible at once under its heading, as the registration form's steps are; `VolunteerSteps` keeps its `folded` prop (closed, with a numbered-list glyph and a summary line, as the register page folds its own) for a page that is not the form. The intro lost its sentence «Organizatorii îți aleg apoi rolul și te confirmă» to the third step, typed once. The third step adds the parent's consent that comes first only where the club takes minors (the notice and the agreement in force describe them, §768); the fourth points to the contact person written at the category (§774) only when a drawn category has one — on the form «scrisă la categoria rolului, mai jos», on the thank-you «din emailul de primire», because the cards are not on that screen and the receipt carries the contacts of the ticked roles' categories (`volunteerStepWords(key, { where })`). No number and no deadline anywhere in it: a volunteer owes nothing between the form and the role.

**After the form.** The thank-you is the registration's «Aproape gata, Ana!» for a volunteer (`volunteers/ui/VolunteerDone.tsx`): the green-disc heading (`shared/ui/DoneHeading.tsx`, now the registration's too) «Mulțumim, Ana!» or «Mulțumim!», the lead «Am primit oferta ta pentru {event}, {date}.» — the date written to stand inside a sentence (`formatDay` with `position: "inline"`: lower-case weekday, «la» before the hour, §452; the page's own line above keeps the start-of-line form) —, one bold sentence about the email, then «Ce urmează» as a list of glyphs without numbers (the registration's has none, and the page's steps number the same step 2) in the steps' own message keys: the receipt email, the parent's consent where minors are taken, the organizers' choice, the day. It replaces the success `Alert`; the test ids `volunteer-done` (now a `role="status"` panel) and `volunteer-done-guardian` stay. **The email sentence is one that is true for every outcome of the post**: «Emailul de primire vine la {email}; dacă ai mai trimis oferta pentru acest eveniment, l-ai primit deja pe primul.» (without the address kept: «la adresa pe care ai scris-o»). It names no hour and no state («pleacă acum», «a plecat»), because `submitVolunteer` queues the receipt only for a new offer: a repeat of the same person («nothing changed, nothing sent»), the loser of a race and a honeypot or timing hit return the same `done` and queue none, the action cannot read an outbox row, and a volunteer who re-sends because the first never came must not be told it is leaving now. So the action seals only the first name and the address in the registration's own facts cookie (`stashSubmittedFacts`, **unchanged** — the registration's cookie is exactly what it was; ten minutes, on the volunteers' path, never in the URL, §14.5), and the page reads it on `?volunteer=1` only. It reads the same for a new person and a repeat (BR-REQ-031-01 criterion 3): it is what was typed, not what the list held. `VOLUNTEER_RECEIVED` stays in the house's «nobody waits for it» list (`email-delay.ts`), now with the comment that says what the page does say. The old `Event.volunteers.done` message is gone.

**Shared pieces, no copy.** The step list is `shared/ui/StepList.tsx` (`StepList`, `StepItem`) and the done heading `shared/ui/DoneHeading.tsx`; `RegistrationSteps` and `CheckYourEmail` now draw theirs with them (same markup, same test ids), so the registration's form, its «Aproape gata» screen and the volunteers' page cannot drift. The two volunteer components are drawn as elements, like every other component of the box.

**The receipt.** `VOLUNTEER_RECEIVED` (templates.ts, both languages) says, after the agreement line and — for a minor — the parent's condition, «Ce urmează: organizatorii îți aleg rolul și te confirmă. Îți scriem pe email rolul tău, cu data și locul, și te căutăm pe email sau la telefon dacă mai trebuie ceva… Până atunci nu ai nimic de făcut» and a line for the day; the order puts the parent's condition before «te confirmă», so a minor reads it first. The subject, the agreement line, the parent's consent line and the not-you line are unchanged. Placeholders only: no number, no deadline, no club name (§357). The club's copy editor starts from the platform's words, so an unedited message shows and sends the new paragraphs; a message the club already saved is an override per type and language and keeps its own words until the club presses «Revino la textul implicit».

**The width.** The page's `Container` is `PAGE_WIDTH` (`xl`), the register page's constant; the form `Stack` lost its 560-pixel cap (§780's follow-up: two-column tiles were narrow on desktop). The category cards, the chips and the banner (§797) span the column. The boxes are the registration form's pairing: one column on a phone, two from `md` — on the left the name, the address and the telephone number, on the right what the person says about themselves (§765) — **and only while there is a right column**: without `profile` the three boxes take the whole width, not half of it beside nothing. The optional message now closes the boxes at full width, after every required one (on a phone and in the tab order, as the registration form orders its optional answers), then the consents and the button.

**The privacy notice's template changed, one sentence.** The volunteers' form sets the registration's facts cookie (the address and first name) on every sign-up, so section 10's list of the forms that set the two ten-minute cookies now names it, through the volunteers' own marker `{{volunteers}}` (the form's name, quoted; no new switch, no new gate). The notice in force keeps its words until the club approves the template, and the changed-template digest and `/admin/tasks` (§639) cover that approval — it joins CLAUDE.md item 16, a lawyer reading the sentence with the volunteers' paragraph. The cookie is strictly necessary and needs no consent; the notice's own list was the thing that had to be true. (The volunteers' form already set the draft cookie on a refusal: the gap was older, this lane widened it.)

**What changed nothing:** the roles' rules, the server validation, the other volunteer emails, the agreement. **Refused:** a second email for the steps; reading the outbox row from the page (a read for a sentence, and it would still not tell a repeat from a first offer); a new cookie; an hour or a «a plecat» on the thank-you.
changelogLine: - **The volunteers' page says what happens, and the form is wider** — four steps under the intro (open at once, the page being the form), a thank-you like the registration's with «Ce urmează» and where the receipt comes, the same facts in the receipt email, and a form as wide as the register page with its boxes in two columns on a desktop. The privacy notice's template names the volunteers' form among those that set the ten-minute cookies. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criteria 33, 39, 40 and 48 (§754, §768, §773, §797). Given an event that takes volunteers, when a visitor opens the volunteers' page, then the page is as wide as the register page (`PAGE_WIDTH`) and the form has no 560-pixel cap, its boxes standing in one column on a phone and in two from `md` up while the form asks what the person says about themselves — the optional message after the required boxes, at full width —; under the intro and above «Ce ești dispus(ă) să faci» stand «Cum funcționează voluntariatul», open at once (the page is the form), four numbered steps and a glyph each — the form, the receipt email, the organizers choosing the role and confirming by email with nothing owed until then, the day — whose third step adds that the parent's consent comes first only where the club takes minors and whose last points to the category's contact person (`below`, on the form) only when one is shown, with no number and no deadline in it; the intro no longer says that the organizers confirm. When the offer was sent, then the thank-you is a status panel (`volunteer-done`) with the heading «Mulțumim, <first name>!» (or «Mulțumim!»), the lead naming the event and its date written inside the sentence (lower-case weekday, «la» before the hour), one sentence that the receipt email comes to the address typed and that a person who already sent an offer for this event has the first receipt — no hour and no state of the email, because a repeat, a lost race and a honeypot hit queue none — and «Ce urmează» as a list without numbers in the steps' own words (its last item pointing to the receipt email, never «below»), with the parent's consent as its second item (`volunteer-done-guardian`) where minors are taken, the same for a new person and a repeat (2026-10-16, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criterion 34. Given a kept offer, when the receipt email `VOLUNTEER_RECEIVED` is sent, then it keeps its subject, the agreement line, the parent's consent line and the not-you line, and says in both languages, after the agreement and the parent's consent, «Ce urmează» — the organizers choose the role and confirm, the role comes by email with the date and place, nothing is owed until then — and a line for the day, with no number, deadline or club name of its own; the club's copy editor starts from those words, and a text the club saved for the message keeps its own until «Revino la textul implicit» (2026-10-16, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends the privacy notice's template. Given the notice's template, then section 10's list of the forms that set the two ten-minute encrypted cookies names the volunteers' form through the marker `{{volunteers}}` in both languages, and a notice approved before keeps its words until the club approves the template (2026-10-16, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: the volunteers' page: the steps and «we will confirm you», before the form and after it, and in the receipt email; a wider form; the notice's cookie sentence names the form
